# MOSDEPTH

Normalize an analysis target BED and measure BAM coverage with mosdepth. For whole-reference analysis, the module builds a BED from the contig lengths in a FASTA index.

Inputs: `alignment` record with `id` (String), `bam` (Path to indexed BAM), `bai` (Path to its index), `ref` (Path to matching FASTA), and `fai` (Path to its index); `target_source` (Path to BED when `has_target` is `true`, otherwise Path to FASTA index); `has_target` (Boolean). Use an ID suitable for a filename. The reference and its index are part of the shared alignment record; this process reads the BAM and `target_source`.

Output: record with the same `id`, normalized `target` BED, mosdepth `summary`, `global_dist`, `region_dist`, compressed `regions` BED, and `regions_index` CSI.

nextflow.enable.types = true

record Alignment {
    id: String
    bam: Path
    bai: Path
    ref: Path
    fai: Path
}

process MOSDEPTH {
    container 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/mosdepth_bedtools:aed7ed405e5a471e'
    cpus 2

    input:
    alignment: Alignment
    target_source: Path
    has_target: Boolean

    stage:
    stageAs target_source, 'target_source.txt'

    output:
    record(
        id: alignment.id,
        target: file('target.bed'),
        summary: file("${alignment.id}.mosdepth.summary.txt"),
        global_dist: file("${alignment.id}.mosdepth.global.dist.txt"),
        region_dist: file("${alignment.id}.mosdepth.region.dist.txt"),
        regions: file("${alignment.id}.regions.bed.gz"),
        regions_index: file("${alignment.id}.regions.bed.gz.csi"),
    )

    script:
    def make_target = has_target
        ? "bedtools sort -i ${target_source} | bedtools merge -i - > target.bed"
        : "awk 'BEGIN { OFS=\"\\t\" } { print \$1, 0, \$2 }' ${target_source} | bedtools sort -i - | bedtools merge -i - > target.bed"
    """
    ${make_target}
    test -s target.bed
    mosdepth -x -t ${task.cpus} -b target.bed --no-per-base ${alignment.id} ${alignment.bam}
    """
}

$schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextflow-io/schemas/refs/heads/main/module/v1/schema.json
name: seqera-services/mosdepth
version: 0.1.0
kind: Process
description: Measure coverage and prepare the analysis target BED.
keywords:
- coverage
- structural variants
- bed
license: MIT
authors:
- Seqera Services
tools:
- mosdepth:
    description: Fast depth calculation for aligned reads.
    documentation: https://github.com/brentp/mosdepth
- bedtools:
    description: Sort and merge target intervals.
    documentation: https://bedtools.readthedocs.io
input:
- name: alignment
  type: record
  description: Record with id (String), bam, bai, ref, and fai (Paths).
- name: target_source
  type: file
  description: User target BED or reference FAI for a whole-reference target.
- name: has_target
  type: boolean
  description: Whether target_source is a BED file.
output:
- - name: id
    type: string
    description: Input ID.
  - name: target
    type: file
    description: Sorted and merged analysis target BED.
  - name: summary
    type: file
    description: Mosdepth summary with mean coverage.
  - name: global_dist
    type: file
    description: Mosdepth global depth distribution.
  - name: region_dist
    type: file
    description: Mosdepth region depth distribution.
  - name: regions
    type: file
    description: Compressed per-region coverage BED.
  - name: regions_index
    type: file
    description: CSI index for the regions BED.
